decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specifed within the application form.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2017/76-01 (Rev A) & 2017/76-02 (Rev A); received 19/09/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those incidental to the application property and shall not be used as primary accommodation such as a living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, study or as a separate unit of accommodation.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the development hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The window and any glazing within the door formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a detached outbuilding to be used as game room, garden store and gym following demolition of the garage in the rear garden.
